title: Bounded orbital transfer search
summary: Inert same-body circular/elliptical transfers; interbody solving remains open.

blocks.text: flight.transfers@1.0.0 requires flight.plans@1.0.0. Bounded generator searches same-body apsis opportunities after a 30-second preparation window and validates every accepted candidate through the selected world predictor. Circular and elliptical starts/targets are supported. Efficient minimizes sampled impulse cost; faster minimizes elapsed wait+travel when at least2% earlier. Neither is a global optimum promise. Unsupported moon/planet relationships explain the current increment limit. No UI, camera, audio, split-screen or view-prediction provider is required. Cancelling the generator closes child forecasts and its cloned context.
